description: Mica looks keenly mystified while keeping both feet planted with the satchel closed. Both wing-arms lift in a compact shrug, one wing tip scratches the teal hoodlet, the beak opens slightly in surprise, and the head tilts strongly. One small cyan reflected glint darts left, then right, then stops indecisively above the attached satchel before fading without forming punctuation or an extra crystal; no hopping, flying or sadness. The emotion must read immediately as genuinely surprised and thoughtfully confused, never sad, ashamed, angry or mocking.

Locked camera and a completely static dark neutral background.
Animate only the supplied approved 2D pixel-art character Mica, A black-and-cream magpie relic keeper with two wings, two feet, teal hoodlet and one brown crystal satchel.

Mica freezes, both amber eyes become extremely wide and the beak opens in a large silent gasp. Both wings lift only a little as a low, symmetrical curved shrug, never straight or above chest height. Keeping both feet planted, Mica looks urgently toward the expected satchel position, checks the opposite side with one sharp head turn, then makes a startled double-take toward the purse that was safely attached all along. The expression melts into bright, sheepish relief. Never hide, drop, open, detach, duplicate or transform the satchel, and create no glints, crystals, symbols, text, new props, floor marks or magical effects.
Preserve the exact approved design, silhouette, pixel-art rendering, proportions, colours, camera angle and these permanent invariants: black-and-cream magpie plumage with subtle blue sheen; exactly two wings and two feet; one teal hoodlet; one brown crystal satchel; two amber eyes.
Keep the full body visible at unchanged scale. Start from the supplied neutral pose and finish settled in that exact pose.
